description: A short, complete 2D role-playing game built one increment per day. Arrive in a valley at dusk where the heart-fire is going out: walk the hand-drawn overworld, talk to the people who stayed, gather the emberseeds into a pouch, follow a quest log, stand a turn-based fight against what guards the dark, and relight the Ember to close the night — the whole run saved so you can continue it.
